title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Articles 158 and 159 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress has discussed the issue of the scope of application of Article 158 and Article 159 of the Criminal Law after the amendment of the Company Law to companies that implement the system of paid-in registration of registered capital and the system of subscribed registration, and hereby provides the following interpretation:
The provisions of Article 158 and Article 159 of the Criminal Law shall apply only to companies that implement the system of paid-in registration of registered capital according to law.
This is hereby announced.
